articles.summary: Rob Saunders' founder journey started with a bad condo closing in Toronto. No one explained the paperwork, questions went unanswered for days, and he got his keys in a paper bag. Instead of complaining, he decided to take matters into his own hands and do something about it. That decision led to co-founding Ownright, a digital real estate law firm that replaces slow, paper-driven closings with a fully online process. This week on Mantle Mondays, Rob shares the founder story behind starting Ownright, from that first frustrating closing to why he believes selling outcomes matters more than selling software.
articles.title: Selling Outcomes, Not Software: How Robert Saunders Built Ownright
